hardware: two NVIDIA RTX A4000 GPUs without NVLink
method: Partition the cylindrical momentum inverse along periodic theta; retain complete axial and radial preconditioner lines on each GPU.

placement_contract.unsafe: Implicitly resharding arrays resident on GPU 0 produced a 9.61% relative error and was rejected.
placement_contract.accepted_for_screening: Create global sharded arrays once from host data, keep all PCG iterations sharded, and compare gathered results on host.

decision.reason: The corrected decomposition is exact and improves the cold coarse row, but warm two-GPU execution is 27.1% slower even with single-reduction PCG. Strong scaling is the acceptance metric.
decision.supported_two_gpu_strategy: Run independent B1 variants concurrently, one per GPU.

next_gate: Do not attempt another placement-only B1 split. Reduce the coarse residual/iteration floor or implement a literature-anchored communication-avoiding solver with a bounded exact scaling gate.
